termination_reason: Monolithic Newton-Raphson tangent non-convexity during localized crack advance
scientific_conclusion: Finer coarse discretization (h=0.60 mm = 2.11*l0) successfully regularized the crack initiation zone, increasing dissipated fracture energy by 659x (10.61 mJ vs 0.016 mJ) across 170 equilibrium increments. However, monolithic Newton-Raphson coupled UEL solver diverged at u_y = 0.0687 mm due to tangent non-convexity during localized process zone softening. This definitively proves that monolithic Newton solvers cannot traverse complete crack propagation on non-adapted macroscopic geometry regardless of mesh seed refinement (h=1.5 mm vs 0.6 mm), establishing that a staggered operator split or crack-following adapted mesh is strictly required to simulate complete severance.
